novel_features.name: Live join on nearest lockers
novel_features.description: See walk-up lockers near a station with live per-size empties attached where Multi Ekicube (nearest bank within 30 m, reservable counts) or the Maihama map publishes them; other lockers have no live field.
novel_features.rationale: Joins coinlocker-navi static facts with Multi Ekicube and Maihama live counts by coordinates and locker id; no site does this.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it when an agent must decide where to drop a bag without a booking and wants live space evidence in one call.

novel_features.name: Hours-window filter
novel_features.description: Keep only lockers open across your drop and pick-up times; unknown hours stay visible and flagged.
novel_features.rationale: Parses free-form 利用時間 and Ekicube weekday hours into a window test the sites do not offer.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it to avoid a locker that closes before the user's last train.

novel_features.name: Gate side across both sources
novel_features.description: Filter lockers by inside or outside the ticket gates using Multi Ekicube data (exactly one bank within 15 m); unknown gate side never matches, so areas without Multi Ekicube banks return no matches.
novel_features.rationale: coinlocker-navi has no gate field; gate side comes only from the Multi Ekicube structured join.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it when the user will not enter the station paid area.

narrative.headline: Walk-up coin lockers in Japan: size, price, IC card, hours, gate side, and live empties where published.
narrative.value_prop: Search コインロッカーなび by station name or coordinates and get normalized, source-dated JSON with explicit unknowns. near --live attaches live per-size empties from Multi Ekicube and the Maihama map; vacancy gives the full live board for one station. Live empties and gate side exist only where Multi Ekicube (JR East) banks or the Maihama Station map publish them; elsewhere those fields are null.

quickstart.comment: Large walk-up lockers that take IC cards
Live reservable empties outside the gates

troubleshoots.fix: The source shows 情報なし for that locker; check locker <id> source_url on site

troubleshoots.symptom: vacancy shows 0 empty but lockers look free
troubleshoots.fix: Multi Ekicube counts reservable boxes only; walk-up boxes can still be free on site

troubleshoots.symptom: near --gate returns few or no rows
troubleshoots.fix: Gate side is known only where exactly one Multi Ekicube bank is within 15 m; other rows are dropped and counted in meta.excluded.gate_unknown
The source throttled the request; wait a minute and retry with a smaller --limit or --max-pages

narrative.when_to_use: Use for walk-up coin lockers in Japan: where to leave a suitcase or day bag without a booking, which sizes and prices, IC card support, hours, and, at Multi Ekicube banks and Maihama Station, gate side and live space.
anti_triggers: Forwarding luggage to a hotel or airport (use yamato-pp-cli)
Reserving a Multi Ekicube locker (use the operator site)
